scientific_question: Can the existing state-aware navigation prompt reduce the dominant next-page loop and produce native Qwen positives on the H1.30 task-identity panel after parser validity is repaired?
hypothesis: Holding model, tasks, seeds, evaluator, horizon, and v2 parser fixed, state-aware-v3 will reduce repeated next actions and increase product/buy-now transitions relative to compact-v2.

treatment.policy: Search once, prefer a plausible product before pagination, cap consecutive Next actions at two, select required options before buy now.

decision_rule: Report the prompt-only paired diagnostic against H1.34; any task-local positive remains non-formal and does not open H1.30 or D0.
claim_boundary: Prompt/navigation diagnostic only. It cannot establish OpenEvo efficacy, teacher benefit, broad model capability, or OpenEvo-versus-SEED superiority.
